shared_problem: Original 48 task identities and domain objectives
Original participants and physical resource counts
Original simulator, tool behavior and outcome checks
Exclusive access to each constrained shared resource
Data dependencies needed to produce the required artifacts
Matched failure settings, repetitions and participant model
hibana_procedure: Global choreography is the only coordination authority
Independent work and resource requests execute in parallel
Both resource grants precede the constrained effect
Resources are returned before unrelated review or private computation
Routes, resolvers and repetition express actual choices and reconsideration
No second progress state, permission table or wrapper hiding Endpoint operations
baseline_policy: Keep comparison implementations and original input files unchanged
checklist_policy: Classify original items as problem constraints, hazards or procedural choices; record procedural departures instead of silently claiming identical control flow

coding_departure.original_items: RA1 through RA3 or RA5 respectively describe sequential acquisition
coding_departure.hibana_execution: Send both independent module Acquire requests before waiting for either grant; send both Return requests before waiting for either acknowledgement
preserved: Original developers, assigned features and module pairs
coding_departure.interface: The projected owner supplies agent_id. Feature strings must name the assigned feature; module strings must contain exactly the assigned pair. Pair order and comma spacing do not matter. Unlike the unchanged simulator's permissive argument matching, malformed or wrong-target requests are returned before any effect
coding_departure.parallelism: All guests, private computation and preparation progress independently; disjoint commits run concurrently. A delayed local test must not hold shared modules or block another developer's commit
coding_departure.scope: 1H requires its own result-driven reconsideration path and is not qualified by these terminal 1E/1M protocols
coding_departure.qualification: Requires persisted direct-WASI evidence and task fidelity review before scored comparisons

writing_departure.original_items: RA1 through RA3, RA5 or RA7 respectively describe sequential acquisition
writing_departure.hibana_execution: Send both independent Acquire requests before waiting for either grant
writing_departure.qualification: Requires persisted direct-WASI evidence and task fidelity review; not yet an accepted scored port

preserved: Original philosophers and adjacent physical forks
Both returned after eat and before finish
All participants complete the original think and eat steps
dining_procedure.hibana_execution: Request both independent forks before waiting for either grant; preserve independent thinking and disjoint eating through one projected global
dining_procedure.caller_binding: The projected owner supplies the original agent_id. The philosopher string remains ordinary input and does not select a participant, matching the original simulator
dining_procedure.scope: The default simulator has one think and one eat step per philosopher; this finite protocol admits each once and rejects subsequent shared operations
dining_procedure.liveness_limit: Completion still requires each model to do its work and the executor/transport to progress; the qualification runs do not prove termination for an uncooperative model
dining_procedure.qualification: Deterministic actual-WASI 3/5/7 person trials pass, with observed disjoint eating 1/2/3; accepted full-task and scored comparisons remain pending

preserved: Original three participants and their assigned operations
Database lease during migration and test-environment lease during integration test
Migration completion before backend effect and backend completion before test effect
Actual pass or fail result delivered to both developers
api_procedure.hibana_execution: WASI requests, service owners, physical resources and result-file endpoints share one global. A result-file open and the result notification are independent inputs in par. The owner replies only after receiving both; subsequent reads use that projected result endpoint
api_procedure.read_boundary: Each developer must read /service/outcome before guest completion. Private files remain independent. A successful pathname lookup alone does not authorize reading a test result
api_procedure.source_conflict: Checklist O2 asks for revisions, while the unchanged task description and simulator specify terminal test failure. Preserve terminal failure and record the conflict; do not report protocol completion as domain success
api_procedure.qualification: Requires actual-WASI evidence for all three failure depths, live Luna trials and a resolved full-task acceptance review before scored comparisons

report_separately: Domain task completion and actual unsafe effects
Rejected attempts returned to the model before an effect
Protocol completion, domain failure, timeout, deadlock and harness errors
Inclusive tokens and elapsed time including waiting and failed attempts
Observed parallel requests and disjoint work, not declared par nodes alone
Shell and service interface differences and implementation maintenance costs
